description.value:
Al Bhed differs only slightly from humes; in their bright green eyes with spiral-patterned irises. They pride themselves on the usage of their specialized knowledge of ancient technology which they call 'Machina'.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Al Bheds gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, and –2 Charisma.
  • Type: Al Bheds are Humanoid creatures with the al bhed subtype.
  • Size: Al Bheds are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
  • Base Speed: Al Bheds have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Al Bheds begin play speaking Common and Albhedian. Al Bheds with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Goblin, Loporrit, Moogle, PuPon, and Yagudo.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Desert Nomad: Al Bheds gain a +4 racial bonus on Constitution checks and Fortitude saves to avoid fatigue, exhaustion, or ill effects from running, forced marches, starvation, thirst, or hot or cold environments.
  • Trap Knowledge: Al Bheds gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws versus mechanical traps.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Weapon Familiarity: Al Bheds are proficient with Simple Firearms.
